headline: 49ers Place TE Jake Tonges On IR
summary: 8:00PM: ESPN’s Adam Schefter confirmed again today that Tonges’ knee injury “wasn’t good.” He reported that the undrafted Cal product is set to miss the rest of the season. Tonges’ injury was diagnosed as a torn MCL, and the 27-year-old will undergo surgery that will keep him on IR for all of 2026. 2:45PM: After […]

headline: Seahawks rule QB Sam Darnold (glute) out vs. Cardinals
summary: The Seahawks ruled out QB Sam Darnold for Sunday's game against the Cardinals due to the glute injury he suffered in Wednesday's season-opening win.

headline: Lions offensive linemen Mahogany, Miller ruled out vs. Bills
summary: A pair of starters won't be playing this week for the Detroit Lions as offensive linemen Christian Mahogany (hip) and Blake Miller (knee) have been ruled out ahead of Thursday night's showdown in Buffalo.

headline: Ravens Place WR Ja’Kobi Lane On IR
summary: Ja’Kobi Lane’s NFL debut was cut short by a wrist injury. The Ravens rookie is now in line for a notable period on the sidelines. It was learned yesterday that Lane will undergo surgery on his wrist. A move to injured reserve became likely as a result, and the Ravens will indeed take that route. […]

headline: Falcons' Penix 'close' to return, still mum on Week 2 status
summary: Falcons QB Michael Penix Jr. didn't rule out playing against the Panthers on Sunday but cautioned he needed to clear some benchmarks before deciding.

headline: Bears anticipate 'great challenge' vs. Brian Flores' Vikings defense
summary: "Coach [Ben Johnson] calls this 'mental war' when you go against versus him, and that's what it is," Bears QB Caleb Williams said of facing a Brian Flores-led defense, which Chicago will do Sunday against Minnesota.
